question: Can a prospectively sealed modern/bygone-times and current/former-season bank serve as pristine confirmation for the next weight-defined factor program?

all is/was capability priors and immutable receipts

prior_art.known_lessons: Capability must precede causal outcomes; v13/v14 are preserved nulls. A global v17 U8 failed on v18 even though H3 stayed stable, so the next data-guided factor hierarchy needs a bank whose text was sealed before that hierarchy exists. Unequal prefix lengths are legal when final semantic suffixes match and later causal code uses explicit suffix alignment.
prior_art.novelty: No v19 bank exists. Sixteen reporter nouns, all target texts, all row IDs, and both target construction surfaces are history-disjoint from v4-v18. The bank is sealed before any revised factor order or v19 causal outcome.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides; no intervention, factor score/order, subspace, or v19 causal outcome is read.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder/digests, construction checks, full-history target-text/row-ID/reporter novelty, and exact 64-row inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least .75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each 16-row A panel has at least 12 rows for which both native base and donor predictions are correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no causal or factor outcome access.

decision: A pass freezes exact v19 confirmation rows without committing to a factor-selection method. A null closes this bank without causal repair and requires a separately authored construction.
